study_sites.name: Göksu Delta & Mersin–Taurus Basin, Turkey
study_sites.theme: Wetland Rhythm, Floodplains & Coastal Soil Moisture (Hometown Study Area)
study_sites.physical_driver: Autumn convective storm pulses across the Göksu watershed raise surface dielectric constant and trigger shallow lagoon inundation; L-band NISAR penetrates coastal reeds while Sentinel-1 C-band captures open specular water attenuation (-6.02 dB).

study_sites.name: Hayward Fault & Sacramento Delta, California, USA
study_sites.theme: Tectonic Shear, Land Subsidence & Levee Integrity (NISAR + UAVSAR L-Band)
study_sites.physical_driver: Repeat-pass L-band interferometry (NISAR GUNW & airborne NASA UAVSAR) preserves phase coherence over vegetated fault scarps and Delta agricultural levees, isolating cm-scale subsidence and fault creep from moisture variability.

study_sites.name: Central Amazon Floodplain, Brazil
study_sites.theme: Canopy Penetration, Double-Bounce Inundation & Forest Disturbance
study_sites.physical_driver: Unlike short C-band waves reflected by top leaves, NISAR L-band (~24 cm wavelength) penetrates dense tropical canopy to bounce off flooded trunks (double-bounce enhancement) and reveals sub-canopy wildfire/clearing loss via sharp RVI drops.

study_sites.name: Malaspina & Yakutat Glacier Corridor, Alaska, USA
study_sites.theme: Glacier Velocity, Ice Marginal Surge & Phase Decorrelation
study_sites.physical_driver: Rapid sub-glacial basal sliding across piedmont glacier lobes shears surface crevasses within a 12-day repeat cycle, causing strong interferometric coherence loss in NISAR GUNW pairs while cold sub-zero air temperatures confirm ice kinematics rather than rain melt.
